record.paper_title: Open Problems on Connectivity of Fibers with Positive Margins in Multi-dimensional Contingency Tables
record.context_brief: Minimal connecting moves under positive margins
record.original_question: Assume all margins of the contingency tables are positive, so that rows or columns with zero marginals are excluded as necessary zeros. Find an algorithm that computes, with respect to set inclusion, a minimum set of Markov moves connecting all tables in the fiber F_T = {n in N^k : A_T(n) = A_T(n_obs)}.

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Assume that all margins are positive. Find an algorithm to compute a min￾imum set of moves connecting all tables in FT in terms of inclusions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A \in \mathbb{Z}^{d \times k}$ be a fixed configuration matrix encoding the marginal (sufficient statistic) map $A_T : \mathbb{N}^k \to \mathbb{Z}^d$, $n \mapsto A n$, of a log-linear model on multi-dimensional contingency tables. For an observed nonnegative integer table $n_{\mathrm{obs}} \in \mathbb{N}^k$, define the fiber
$$F_T \;=\; \{\, n \in \mathbb{N}^k : A_T(n) = A_T(n_{\mathrm{obs}})\,\}.$$
A Markov move is an integer vector $m \in \mathbb{Z}^k$ with $A m = 0$. A finite set $\mathcal{M} \subset \ker_{\mathbb{Z}}(A)$ connects $F_T$ if for every $n, n' \in F_T$ there exist $n = n_0, n_1, \dots, n_r = n'$ in $F_T$ and moves $m_{i} \in \pm\mathcal{M}$ with $n_{i} = n_{i-1} + m_i$.

Restrict attention to fibers $F_T$ in which all margins of every table $n \in F_T$ are strictly positive (rows or columns with structural zero marginals are excluded as necessary zeros). 

Provide an algorithm that, given $A$ and a description of the positive-margin constraint, computes a set $\mathcal{M}$ of Markov moves connecting every such fiber $F_T$ and that is minimum with respect to set inclusion among all such connecting sets.
artifact.status_search_result: Related work (Markov subbases under positive margins, quotient-ideal/primary-decomposition approaches by Engström–Kahle–Sullivant and Yoshida and collaborators) gives connecting move sets in special models (e.g., logistic regression, certain graphical models) but does not provide a general algorithm computing an inclusion-minimum connecting set under the positive-margin assumption. No source found announcing a general algorithmic solution; the problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Markov Chains, Quotient Ideals, and Connectivity with Positive Margins
status_evidence.snippet: positive margins are shown to allow a set of Markov connecting moves much simpler than the full Markov basis (a Markov subbasis under positive margins).
status_evidence.claim: Special-case results exist for connecting moves under positive margins, but no general inclusion-minimum algorithm is given.

status_evidence.title: Positive margins and primary decomposition
status_evidence.snippet: Many graphical models have the positive margins property: all fibers with strictly positive marginals are connected by quadratic moves corresponding to conditional independence.
status_evidence.claim: Connectivity under positive margins is studied algebraically; no general algorithm for inclusion-minimum connecting sets is provided.

status_evidence.title: Markov bases and subbases for bounded contingency tables
status_evidence.snippet: Computing a reduced number of moves connecting all tables, instead of a full Markov basis, is important; positive margins can drastically reduce the move count.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the question of minimum connecting subbases remains an active topic without a general algorithm.
